name: zensudoku
title: zensudoku
description: Sudoku with value, corner and center notes (cleared as you place digits), colors, undo and redo, hints, and a killer cage and sandwich calculator; plays SudokuPad puzzles from a source or a local library. A standalone PWA, a zenbot plugin with an inline Sudoku helper, and an MCP App.
author: Zegoverno

games.title: Sudoku
games.description: Classic Sudoku with notes, colors, undo and hints; the agent can check your board and coach you.

commands.name: sudoku
commands.description: Open a Sudoku: the example, 81 digits (. for blank), or a SudokuPad source.
